other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent/native resident of Uttarakhand
Applicant must not be a defaulter of any nationalized bank, financial institution, cooperative institution or other institution
Applicant must have necessary knowledge regarding the conduct of the proposed activity
Applicant must be an account holder of the financing bank of the concerned area
If any permission or clearance is required for the operation/re‑operation of the business, it must be obtained from the competent authority of the particular area
Ex‑servicemen/women, disabled persons, Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe candidates must attach a self‑attested copy of the certificate issued by the competent authority with the application form
benefits_summary: Provides a loan up to Rs 50,000 at 8% interest with a 25% subsidy (70% loan) and no educational barriers.
documents_required: Self‑attested copy of the certificate issued by the competent authority (for ex‑servicemen/women, disabled, SC, ST)
